response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer, but the role requires native-level Japanese, strong C for UNIX, Linux kernel source-code modification experience, and embedded networking/security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced. His C/C++ exposure is brief (a 7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015), and his career trajectory has moved toward TypeScript/Node.js web platforms, making this a fundamental mismatch on hard requirements.
strengths: Long, varied software engineering career with strong testing and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some systems-level exposure: DLang low-latency services, Linux, and a C++/Linux audio thesis project
Fluent English and strong ability to work with technical documentation and open-source communities
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency (native-level Japanese is a hard requirement)
No Linux kernel analysis/modification, embedded firmware, or switch/networking product experience
No demonstrated security-domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection)

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking/security or Linux kernel experience
Solid general engineering experience and Linux familiarity
